messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER — P1: High 5xx error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 (threshold 5% -> observed 18%). Paging oncall @maya. Incident created: INC-2026-0423-01

Maya Chen: acked. jumping on it now, taking lead. digging into recent deploys and autoscale.

Maya Chen: quick status: errors started ~03:12 UTC, coincides with rollout of runtime patch `infer-engine:1.18.2`. Rolling back to previous runtime in parallel.

Samir Patel: I see the same in logs — `kv-cache` lookup spiking with OOM-ish traces. grabbing pod logs.

Samir Patel: pastebin of error head:```
2026-04-23T03:13:05Z ERROR infer-runtime: kv-cache eviction failed: OOM
stacktrace: allocate_kv_cache(0x1f4) -> gpu_alloc failed: out of memory
...
```

Eric Park: I can flip traffic to a canary variant (smaller model quantized) if we want to preserve latency while rollback finishes.

Maya Chen: yes do that. `route-policy canary-smallmodel` — move 20% traffic. Eric, can you run that?

Eric Park: running now: `redwoodctl route set --route /v1/generate --variant small-quant --weight 20` — ✅ 03:20 UTC

Olivia Nguyen: tagging customer-impact: a bunch of API retries started around 03:14. CS already seeing tickets. Putting draft message in #customer-impact.

Maya Chen: rollback of infer-engine to 1.18.1 in progress. patch rollback triggered on host pool 3 -> 03:23 UTC.

Samir Patel: after shifting 20% to small-quant I still see error rate drop from 18% -> 7% in last 2 mins. Rolling pod restart on affected nodes to clear stale KV handles.

Maya Chen: quick mitigation summary: 1) Canaried 20% to smaller model (Eric) 2) Rollback runtime (Maya) 3) Restart affected pods (Samir) 4) Notify CS (Olivia).

Jessica King: tagging legal & compliance for any regulated-customer impact. Any PHI/exfil concerns?

Olivia Nguyen: not seeing PHI in logs. primary impact: degraded generations and higher latency; customers saw 5xx + timeouts. listing top impacted tenants: AcmeCorp, BetaApps, LearnX (based on error counts).

Samir Patel: pods restarted completed 03:29 UTC. After full rollback and restarts error rate down to 1.1% -> back within SLO.

Maya Chen: status update: incident mitigated at 03:31 UTC. marking incident as mitigated. moving to post-incident actions: need RCA + postmortem.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0423-01 status changed to 'mitigated' by Maya Chen at 03:31 UTC. Please file postmortem within 72 hours and add action items.

Olivia Nguyen: scheduling postmortem meeting — I can host 04/24 16:00 UTC or 04/25 09:00 UTC. preference?

Maya Chen: 04/24 16:00 works for me.

Eric Park: 04/24 16:00 also good.

Samir Patel: fine for me. I'll start a draft RCA timeline and add logs.

Maya Chen: action items (assigning now):
- Samir Patel: draft initial RCA timeline and root-cause analysis (due 04/24 12:00 UTC).
- Maya Chen: review RCA and add mitigation plan + release gating checklist updates (due 04/25 12:00 UTC).
- Eric Park: add routing fallback automation task (PR + tests) (due 05/01 23:59 UTC).
- Olivia Nguyen: prepare external customer impact summary for CS and support playbook (due 04/24 18:00 UTC).
- Jessica King: legal review for impacted tenants + compliance note (due 04/26 12:00 UTC).

Samir Patel: starting timeline draft here:
```
03:11:42 UTC - infer-engine:1.18.2 rollout started to host pool 3
03:12:55 UTC - spike in kv-cache eviction and GPU alloc failures (first 50x 5xx)
03:14:05 UTC - monitoring alerts crossed P1 threshold (18% 5xx)
03:18:00 UTC - oncall paged, initial triage
03:20:12 UTC - route policy canary to small-quant (20%) (Eric)
03:23:40 UTC - runtime rollback triggered (Maya)
03:29:12 UTC - pods restarted, kv-cache state cleared (Samir)
03:31:04 UTC - system error rate stabilized to 1.1% -> mitigated
```

Samir Patel: initial suspected contributing factors: regression in `infer-engine:1.18.2` memory accounting change + insufficient canary gating (rollout to full pool before KV-pressure tests).

Maya Chen: agreed. two quick remediation proposals:
- Add pre-release kv-cache pressure test to the CI e2e job. (low friction)
- Change default rollout strategy to `canary->staged` with smaller initial host pool and automated rollback on OOM metrics.

Eric Park: also propose an automated emergency route toggle in the control plane: `--emergency-route` that moves traffic to quantized/smaller variants and drains new sessions; can be invoked by oncall. I'll file design PR.

Olivia Nguyen: for customer comms — draft to CS: short summary + timeline + mitigation + next steps + apology + ETA for postmortem (link to postmortem when ready). I'll post after we finalize timeline.

Jessica King: noted. I'll loop in compliance if any tenant asked for formal notification.

Maya Chen: reviewers for RCA: Maya (ops review) + Jessica (legal/comms review). Samir will be primary author. Once draft ready, ping `#postmortems` and add to docs: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-0423-01 (create page).

Samir Patel: draft will be uploaded 04/24 11:00 UTC. requesting reviewers to comment by 04/24 14:00 UTC so we can finalize before meeting.

Eric Park: putting a security note — check any model cache keys rotated or leaked during OOMs. Samir can you confirm?

Samir Patel: looked through logs, no evidence of key exfil. cache handles were internal pointers; will include confirmation in RCA.

Maya Chen: any other immediate follow-ups?

Olivia Nguyen: adding one more action: update runbook playbook for `5xx-spike` to include this specific kv-cache OOM symptom set (owner: Maya, due 04/30).

Jessica King: sign-off process: after reviewers comment, I'll provide final sign-off and coord external comms.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. closing the active page. See y'all in the postmortem meeting. :white_check_mark:
